title: With Amharic selected, most core screens stay in English
steps: Local: set empire_lang=am, open /landing, /login, /analytics, /account, /orders at 390 px.
Headings, buttons and help text are English; only a few labels are Amharic.
Count: 29 of 297 .tsx files call useTranslation; at least 184 JSX text nodes of three or more English words.
expected: Every user-facing string comes from the locale files, so choosing Amharic translates the whole interface.
actual: The locale files are complete for the keys they have, but most screens never use them. Amharic users see a mixed-language app, including on sign-in and order actions.
impact: Amharic is offered as a language in the primary market but does not deliver; trust and usability suffer for users who read Amharic first.
fix: Extract strings screen by screen into en.json/am.json (core journeys first: landing, sign-in/up, feed, marketplace, product, cart/checkout, orders, account); add an ESLint rule (i18next/no-literal-string) in warn mode with a ratchet like the strict-type one.
regression_test: Lint ratchet: count of literal JSX strings per file may only go down.
